big: Silver is more than a metal for jewellery. Industrial uses are nearly 60% of demand: electronics, solar, EVs and AI hardware. Industry is the big buyer.

lines: Installations grow, but solar silver demand is expected to fall about 19% in 2026 due to thrifting, which means using less silver per panel. Physical investment in bars and coins is expected to rise about 20%. Indian investment demand is a highlighted growth driver.
